title: Early response of anti-vascular endothelial growth factor (anti-VEGF) in diabetic macular edema (DME) management: microperimetry and optical coherence tomography (OCT) findings: a pilot study at national eye center of third world country

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License)

condition: Centre-involving diabetic macular edema (type 2 diabetes; severe NPDR or PDR), eyes receiving intravitreal anti-VEGF for the first time; prospective analytical observational pilot study (Cicendo National Eye Center, Bandung), 16 eyes of 12 patients

groups.description: All study eyes; OCT and microperimetry before the first loading injection and 1 week and 1 month after it; at least three injections one month apart were planned

series.notes: Mean ± SD (µm); Table 4 is a pairwise-comparison layout that repeats the pre-injection, 1-week and 1-month cells (R4C2, R6C2, R7C2 duplicate R2C3, R3C2, R5C2); 1 week = 0.2300 months; the 1-month visit follows the first injection only (Figure 2 legend: '1 month after the injection of the first loading dose'), so the reported period contains one injection; per-visit n not reported

exclusions.reason: changes duplicated by the absolute series; p-values are not admissible

exclusions.what: Table 4 duplicate pairwise rows (R4, R6, R7)

exclusions.reason: not tabulated; only extreme areas are given in text; sector values without a complete central series

exclusions.what: Retinal sensitivity (Table 3, Figures 4 and 6), Table 2 CMT-RS correlation and Figure 5 regression

notes: Time origin: the first intravitreal bevacizumab injection (treatment-naive eyes; 2 eyes had prior PRP and 2 prior cataract surgery; prior DME therapy was an exclusion criterion)
Device named inconsistently: 'Stratus OCT scanner (Cirrus HD 5000; Carl Zeiss Meditech GmbH, Germany)' with the Fast Macular Thickness protocol (6 radial 6-mm scans), so device recorded as unstated

Measure: the Methods describe the ETDRS grid with a 1-mm central zone and state that only subfield areas 1-5 were used, but they do not define the tabulated 'Central macular thickness (CMT)'; the Results text calls area-specific values 'CMT' too and gives area-1 (central) values at week 1 and month 1 that differ from the tabulated CMT, so the tabulated CMT may not be the central-subfield mean (it may average several ETDRS areas); recorded as central_unspecified
The study pooled area-level observations for the CMT-RS correlation and regression; whether the Table 4 SD is over eyes or eye-areas is not stated
Visual acuity, retinal sensitivity and fixation stability exist but are not extracted
